assumptions: Part identities for Figure 2A are not visible; each construct is assumed to be 1 promoter (19 different type 2 promoter plasmids) + type 3 GFP + type 4 terminator + pWS064 backbone (4 plasmids per reaction); one promoter per well, construct 1-19 in column-major well order A1:H2 then A3:C3.

Part stocks normalized to 50 fmol/µL so 1 µL gives 50 fmol each; 10x NEB T4 ligase buffer (1 µL) and water (4 µL) fill the 10 µL reaction (standard practice; enzyme units match NEB stock concentrations). Master mix made for 21 reactions (19 + 2 overage); GG performed in 96-well plate wells instead of single tubes.
Ranges like A1:H2 are expanded column-major (A1..H1, A2..H2); source and destination lists pair in the same order.

E. coli transformation (NEB 5-alpha high-efficiency protocol, https://www.neb.com/en/protocols/high-efficiency-transformation-protocol-c2987?pdf=true): 30 min ice, 42 °C 30 s, 5 min ice, SOC, 37 °C 60 min at 250 rpm. NEB Turbo protocol assumed equivalent; strain used for YTK OT-2 run not stated so 5-alpha F'Iq was chosen. Volumes scaled down 1/5 for the miniaturized format: 10 µL cells, 1 µL GG reaction, 190 µL SOC.

6-well plates with 5 mL LB agar adapted to 96-well agar plates (170 µL agar per well, area-scaled to ~0.32 cm²); 10 µL of the recovery culture plated per well (assumed). Ampicillin 100 µg/mL assumed for the pWS064 Level 1 vector (the paper lists it among its antibiotics; confirm on plasmid record). Competent cells, SOC and plates are assumed commercial/prepared stocks.

Colony PCR: colony resuspended in 20 µL water in a 96-well plate, 1 µL used (assumed; Phire dilution buffer is an alternative per https://tools.thermofisher.com/content/sfs/manuals/MAN0012959_Phire_Plant_Direct_PCR_MasterMixes_UG.pdf). Reaction scaled from the Phire user guide: 10 µL reaction = 5 µL 2x master mix, 0.5 µM each primer (0.5 µL of 10 µM), sample, water to volume; master mix 9 µL + 1 µL template as in paper. Cycling: initial denaturation 98 °C for 5 min per Phire guide; remaining cycle count, annealing and extension times were not retrieved and are assumed to be set by amplicon size and primer Tm per the manual. Primers (Table S1) assumed to flank the insertion site; one white colony per construct (19) used.

Plasmid prep: 3 mL LB cultures adapted to 1.8 mL in a 96-deep-well plate; the whole plate is inoculated assuming all 19 are PCR positive; silica miniprep, ~100 ng/µL eluate assumed. NotI-HF digest: ~1 µg in 20 µL, 10 µL plasmid + 7 µL water + 2 µL 10x rCutSmart + 1 µL NotI-HF (20 U), 37 °C 1 h; 65 °C 20 min heat-kill assumed.

Yeast transformation volumes follow the paper (100 µL cells, 64 µL DNA mix incl. ~500 ng linearized DNA and 10 µL ssDNA, 296 µL PEG/LiOAc, 42 °C 40 min, 200 µL 5 mM CaCl2) in a deep-well plate. DNA mix water 44 µL assumed so that 10 µL digest (~500 ng assumed) + 10 µL ssDNA + 44 µL water = 64 µL. Wash volume (1 mL), culture scale (pooled 15 mL cultures to supply 19 reactions), centrifuge 3000 x g 5 min, supernatant removal volumes and ssDNA 10 mg/mL stock boiled and chilled on ice are assumed.

Selective dropout plates adapted to 96-well SC-Leu agar (170 µL per well); 10 µL of the 200 µL transformation spotted per well instead of whole-volume plating (assumed). SC-Leu uses CSM-Leu at manufacturer-recommended concentration (~0.7 g/L, assumed) with the paper's 0.17% YNB, 0.5% ammonium sulfate, 2% glucose, 2% agar.

Flow cytometry cultures: 3 independent colonies per construct (triplicates; 57 wells) in SC-Leu in 96-deep-well plates, 1 mL overnight preculture at 30 °C with shaking, diluted 1:40 (25 µL into 975 µL) into fresh SC-Leu targeting OD600 0.1-0.2 (assumed), grown 6 h at 30 °C with shaking. Layout: replicate 1 in A1:H2 + A3:C3, replicate 2 in A5:H6 + A7:C7, replicate 3 in A9:H10 + A11:C11 (construct order identical in each block). No untransformed BY4741 control is included.

Flow readout: 2 µL culture into 198 µL PBS (1/100) in 96-well plate; voltages per paper (FSC 300 V, SSC 350 V, BL1 500 V), 10,000 events; autosampler draw volume, flow rate, rinse and gating are not specified and analysis is not included.
Thermocycling steps (GG, colony PCR) are manual steps in the Opentrons thermocycler or benchtop cycler; plate sealing, centrifugation, shaking and picking are manual.
